target.statement: FID score of DCM2IT for multi-domain translation on the Season dataset (quantitative comparison against StarGAN/DosGAN/ComboGAN)
target.table_ref: Table 3/4 (quantitative comparison on Season dataset; exact table number not visible in provided text)

code_links: https://github.com/junyanz/pytorch-CycleGAN-and-pix2pix (only a baseline/data link, not the paper's own code)

compute.basis: No official code exists; the full DCM2IT framework (two-stage training: domain-style extractor pre-training + multi-domain disentangled GAN with MMD, AdaIN, LSGAN) must be reimplemented from scratch and trained on ~6000 images at 216x216, which is a multi-hour-to-multi-day GPU training run.

blockers: No official implementation released (only a CycleGAN baseline repo is linked)
Full method must be reimplemented from the paper text
GAN training on CPU is impractically slow (many hours to days)
Season dataset requires scraping/curating from Flickr (original Anoosheh et al. collection)
title: Unsupervised Multi-Domain Multimodal Image-to-Image Translation with Explicit Domain-Constrained Disentanglement
